title: Towards Trustworthy Retrieval Augmented Generation for Large Language Models: A Survey

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying methods that quantify gender-related biases in ranking lists, evaluate the impact of retrieval models, and measure equitable representation across retrieved image sets and generated text.
Reviewing frameworks that assess demographic diversity and equitable representation across race, ethnicity, and skin tone categories in retrieved content and generative conditioning.
Examining techniques that ensure balanced representation and demographic diversity across age categories when sampling external data sources for retrieval-augmented generation.
Surveying the use of benchmarks (like the BBQ dataset) to evaluate biases in LLM-generated responses by examining their reliance on societal stereotypes and anti-stereotypes in ambiguous contexts.
Evaluating the susceptibility of RAG systems to targeted adversarial attacks (e.g., BadRAG) designed to steer sentiment or responses regarding specific political parties and candidates.
Reviewing evaluation tracks (such as the TREC Fair Ranking Track) that measure fair exposure to demographics by utilizing query subsets related to location.
